review.assessment: The change introduces `solution.py` with a `retry` helper that catches all exceptions but leaves the handler as a bare `pass`. As written, it silently exits the loop and returns `None` when all attempts fail, directly contradicting both the task requirement and its own docstring which state the final exception must be re-raised. No other structural or logical issues were observed.
